none: PAS FindID 1001436: Roman coin: contemporary copy of a nummus of Crispus
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete copper-alloy Roman contemporary copy of a nummus of Crispus dating to the period AD 321-3 (Reece Period 16). BEATA TRAN-QVILLITAS reverse type depicting globe on altar inscribed VOT//IS/XX with three stars above. Mint of Trier. This coin type is not recorded within RIC
